# NEW 2026-11-24 v25.0 Colonization 4.0 (oe_col4_, 0 mainline slots, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v250_colonization4.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# 1. Manual Overseas Enclave Consolidation Decision (T1)
oe_col4_dec_consolidate_overseas = {
	decision_category = expansion_decisions
	potential = {
		oe_col4_has_consolidatable_enclaves = yes
	}
	allow = {
		at_war = no
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_col4_manual_consol_cd }
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		value = 15
	}
	illustration_tags = { 10 = exterior }
	illustration_scope = {
		event_illustration_poptype_effect = {
			foreground = pop_type:burghers
			background = pop_type:soldiers
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_col4_dec_consolidate_overseas.a
		effect = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_col4_manual_consol_cd value = 1 days = 365 }
			random_owned_location = {
				limit = {
					is_capital = no
					NOT = { continent = root.capital.continent }
					OR = {
						NOT = { is_core_of = root }
						AND = {
							root = { is_ai = no }
							oe_col4_is_colonial_frontier_loc = yes
						}
					}
					save_temporary_scope_as = oe_col4_enclave_loc
					root = {
						any_subject = {
							oe_col4_is_overseas_colonial_subject = yes
							exists = capital
							capital.region = scope:oe_col4_enclave_loc.region
						}
					}
				}
				region = { save_scope_as = oe_col4_region }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:oe_col4_region }
				ordered_subject = {
					limit = {
						oe_col4_is_overseas_colonial_subject = yes
						exists = capital
						capital = { region ?= scope:oe_col4_region }
					}
					order_by = total_population
					max = 1
					save_scope_as = target_colony
				}
				if = {
					limit = { exists = scope:target_colony }
					if = {
						limit = { is_ai = yes }
						oe_col4_transfer_region_to_colony = yes
						scope:target_colony = { oe_col4_apply_unified_colonial_name = yes }
					}
					else = {
						trigger_event_non_silently = oe_col4.1
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# 2. Global Columbian Exchange 2.0: Old World Imports New World Crops (Age IV+, T3)
oe_col4_dec_import_new_world_crops = {
	decision_category = economy_decisions
	potential = {
		oe_col4_can_import_nw_crops = yes
	}
	allow = {
		gold >= 120
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_col4_ce_ow_cd }
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = {
				gold >= 260
				at_war = no
			}
			add = 12
		}
	}
	illustration_tags = { 10 = exterior }
	illustration_scope = {
		event_illustration_poptype_effect = {
			foreground = pop_type:peasants
			background = pop_type:burghers
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_col4_dec_import_new_world_crops.a
		effect = {
			add_gold = -120
			set_variable = { name = oe_col4_ce_ow_cd value = 1 days = 3650 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_col4.30
		}
	}
}
